_doc: THE BEATING SHAPES — HIS RULES for a beating pair rolled by tools/beat_pair.js --roll (DEC-62; RUNNING_LOG §269 · §270). A PAIR = a player's long note and a STATIC sine brick at the same pitch; the note is bent so the pair beats along a SHAPE, said in beats a second (Hz). HIS DATA: the rules are his dictation, the numbers marked (AI) are the AI's starts that he accepted with 'Okay, good' — his ear's to move. A number changed here is used at the next roll; nothing is rebuilt by itself.
_levels: the written dynamics: the sine brick's mark · the player's note (its velocity by the PAGE's own rule for a mark — p 37 · mp 55, what his hand makes in the page). lanes = a lane's OWN marks, by its instrument: the cello's sine fff is HIS, by ear (DEC-61); the viola's sine mf and note pp HIS (DEC-67: 'down one notch', from f and p); the bass flute's sine mf and note pp HIS (DEC-68); the crotales — the sine AND the note mp — HIS (DEC-66: 'let's make both the sine and the crotales mp'). sine · note = any lane not named (the note p, his; the sine f, AI — the bass clarinet's so far).
_gapS: the silence between two pairs on a lane: a plain roll, equal chance, in this range (his: 'a simple roll'; 4 … 7 first, 6 … 11 since DEC-71).
_shapes: the three shapes and how often each is rolled (weights; equal — AI). upHold: from the unison up to the peak, held · downHold: it begins AT the peak, comes down, held · upPlateauDown: up to the peak, a plateau, back down, a last hold.
_peakHz: the peak beating, beats a second: at least the first, at most the second (his: 3 and 10). It LEANS LOW (the smaller of two rolls — AI): a high peak forces a long note.
_floorHz: a descent never reaches the unison: it ends at this rate or above (his: 0.6). endMaxShare: … and at most this share of its peak (AI: half) — a plain roll between the two.
_paceSPerHz: THE GLISS PACE: seconds for the beating to change by 1 a second. The first number is the FASTEST allowed (his: 1 Hz in 2.5 s); the second the slowest rolled (AI: 6). Each rise and each fall rolls its own, leaning fast (the smaller of two rolls).
_hold: a hold or a plateau: at least holdMinS (his: 2.5), plus an extra of 0 … holdExtraMaxS (AI: 8) that leans short (the smaller of two rolls).
_maxLengthS: a pair whose parts sum past this is rolled again (his: 60, 'probably never get there'). The length is never rolled: it is the sum of the parts.
